ns0:problem.ns0:para: Use the graph of the function to find its domain and range. Write the domain and range in interval notation.

ns0:media.alt: This figure has a curved line segment graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The y-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The curved line segment goes through the points (negative 5, negative 4), (0, negative 3), and (1, 2). The interval [negative 5, 1] is marked on the horizontal axis. The interval [negative 4, 2] is marked on the vertical axis.

ns0:solution.ns0:para: The domain is [−5,1]. The range is [−4,2].
